question: Which is the national heritage animal of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elephant**__.

__
 
• **The elephant is the national heritage animal of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The elephant was declared the **National Heritage Animal of India** in **2010**.
 
• **World Elephant Day** is observed every year on **August 12**.
 
• India is home to the second-highest number of elephants used for tourism in Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
